exposure: indications for CS (previous CS, failure of progress, fetal distress)
cohort: The study included 790 pregnant women who had delivered by elective or emergency cesarean section.
finding: The incidence of CS was 34.6%, and the common indications were previous CS (22.1%), failure of progress (11.9%), and fetal distress (10%).
mod_finding: The study found a CS incidence of 34.6% in the region, which was twice the WHO recommendation, with previous CS, failure of progress, and fetal distress being the commonest indications.
